title_en: The Boeing Freighters Replacing The McDonnell Douglas MD-11
title_zh: 波音货机取代麦道MD-11
summary: The MD-11 is disappearing from cargo fleets. Discover how Boeing's 767 and 777 freighters are replacing the legendary trijet at UPS and FedEx.
summary_zh: MD-11 正在从货运机队中消失。了解波音 767 和 777 货机如何取代 UPS 和 FedEx 传奇的三喷气机。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

The McDonnell Douglas MD-11 has been a workhorse of the global air cargo industry since it entered service in 1990. While passenger airlines had largely abandoned the three-engine widebody, UPS and FedEx continued to rely on it to move millions of packages across their networks. That era is now coming to an end, but replacing the MD-11 is proving more complicated than simply ordering another freighter.

UPS has already retired all 26 of its MD-11s, turning to Boeing 767-300 freighters to help restore its lost capacity. FedEx has taken a different approach, retaining 29 examples as of May 2026 and planning to withdraw the fleet by the end of 2032. So, which Boeing aircraft are taking over the MD-11's workload, and why are cargo operators choosing a combination of smaller and larger freighters instead of a direct replacement?
Why The MD-11 Is Disappearing From Cargo Fleets

The MD-11 enjoyed a much longer career in cargo operations than it did in passenger service. Developed by McDonnell Douglas as a long-range widebody trijet, it offered airlines and freight operators a combination of substantial payload capacity and intercontinental range. Although passenger airlines gradually replaced it with newer twin-engine aircraft, cargo companies found plenty of work for the aging aircraft.

UPS and FedEx became two of its most important operators. The MD-11 was well suited to their overnight delivery networks, which require aircraft capable of carrying large shipments between major sorting hubs. Its three-engine configuration was also less of a concern when cargo demand justified the operating costs.

However, the economics of operating older three-engine aircraft have changed. Modern twin-engine freighters can carry substantial loads over long distances while requiring fewer engines, reducing maintenance requirements and fuel consumption. The Boeing 777F , for example, offers more structural payload than the MD-11 while covering long-haul routes without a third engine.

The decisive moment for the MD-11 came on November 4, 2025, when UPS Flight 2976 crashed shortly after takeoff from Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport (SDF). The accident killed all three crew members and 11 people on the ground. Following the crash, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an emergency airworthiness directive prohibiting MD-11 operations until the required inspections and corrective actions had been completed. The National Transportation Safety Board's investigation documented the accident and continues to examine its circumstances.

UPS subsequently decided to retire its entire MD-11 fleet instead of returning the aircraft to service. FedEx, however, chose to resume operations after the necessary inspections and retain the remaining aircraft for several more years. The two companies now face the same challenge, but their replacement strategies look very different.
How UPS Is Replacing Its MD-11 Fleet With Boeing 767 Freighters

UPS had already established a substantial Boeing 767 operation before retiring its MD-11s. According to its 2025 Annual Report , the company listed 26 MD-11 aircraft in its fleet figures and confirmed that it had permanently grounded and retired the entire type during the fourth quarter of 2025. At year-end, UPS had 99 Boeing 767-300 aircraft and another 18 on order, according to AeroCorner .

This made the 767 a natural choice for rebuilding capacity. UPS did not need to introduce an unfamiliar aircraft into its operations, and its existing fleet provided a foundation for handling additional shipments. The company also operates Boeing 757 , 747, and Airbus A300 aircraft, giving its network other options for distributing freight, according to planespotters.net .

The retirement nevertheless came with a financial cost. In its June 2026 financial filing , UPS reported that it had taken delivery of five additional Boeing 767-300 aircraft during the first six months of 2026. And, as of November 2026, the airline already operates 110 Boeing 767 aircraft. The company accounted for these aircraft as finance leases. The company also acknowledged that the loss of the MD-11 fleet had increased third-party aircraft leasing expenses as it dealt with capacity constraints.

There is a catch, though. The Boeing 767-300F is not a direct replacement for the MD-11 in terms of payload or range. The 767 belongs to a smaller widebody category, meaning that UPS cannot simply assign every former MD-11 route to a single 767 and expect identical results. Some shipments may need to be distributed across additional flights or transferred to larger aircraft.

UPS can use its Boeing 747 freighters on longer routes that require greater payload capacity, while the 767s handle smaller shipments and shorter sectors. This approach allows the company to match aircraft size to demand, though it also requires careful scheduling. FedEx, meanwhile, has chosen to keep its MD-11s flying while it builds up its replacement capacity.
Why FedEx Is Keeping Its Remaining MD-11s Until 2032

FedEx is taking a much slower approach to retiring its MD-11 fleet. Its 2026 Annual Report recorded 29 MD-11s as of May 31, 2026, alongside 59 Boeing 777Fs and 152 Boeing 767Fs. The company plans to retire the remaining three-engine aircraft by the end of 2032.

The decision follows an earlier change in FedEx's fleet plans. In 2023, the company had targeted the end of 2028 for the retirement of its MD-11 fleet . However, it extended the deadline in 2025, explaining that the revised schedule would better match aircraft capacity with anticipated shipment volumes. In other words, FedEx decided that keeping the aircraft for longer made more sense than withdrawing them before replacement capacity was needed.

The November 2025 grounding also disrupted FedEx's operations. The company explained in its annual report that the FAA issued an emergency airworthiness directive prohibiting MD-11 flights until the required inspections and corrective actions were completed. Following FAA approval of Boeing-developed inspection and return-to-service protocols in May 2026 , FedEx began bringing its aircraft back into commercial service. It expected the entire fleet to return to service by the end of calendar year 2026.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
麦道 MD-11 自 1990 年投入使用以来一直是全球航空货运业的主力。虽然客运航空公司基本上放弃了三引擎宽体飞机，但 UPS 和联邦快递仍然依靠它在其网络中运输数百万件包裹。那个时代现已结束，但事实证明，更换 MD-11 比简单地订购另一架货机更为复杂。
UPS 已经退役了全部 26 架 MD-11，转而使用波音 767-300 货机来帮助恢复其损失的运力。联邦快递采取了不同的方法，截至 2026 年 5 月保留了 29 架，并计划在 2032 年底前撤出机队。那么，哪些波音飞机正在接管 MD-11 的工作量，为什么货运运营商选择小型和大型货机的组合而不是直接替换？
为什么 MD-11 从货运机队中消失
MD-11 在货运业务中的使用寿命比在客运服务中的使用寿命要长得多。它由麦道公司开发，是一款远程宽体三喷气机，为航空公司和货运运营商提供了强大的有效载荷能力和洲际航程的结合。尽管客运航空公司逐渐用更新的双引擎飞机取代了它，但货运公司为老化的飞机找到了很多工作。
UPS 和 FedEx 成为其最重要的两家运营商。 MD-11 非常适合他们的隔夜配送网络，该网络需要飞机能够在主要分拣中心之间运送大量货物。当货运需求证明运营成本合理时，其三引擎配置也不那么令人担忧。
然而，运营老式三引擎飞机的经济效益已经发生了变化。现代双引擎货机可以长距离承载大量负载，同时需要更少的发动机，从而减少维护要求和燃油消耗。例如，波音 777F 提供比 MD-11 更多的结构有效载荷，同时无需第三台发动机即可覆盖长途航线。
MD-11 的决定性时刻发生在 2025 年 11 月 4 日，当时 UPS 2976 号航班从路易斯维尔穆罕默德·阿里国际机场 (SDF) 起飞后不久坠毁。事故导致 3 名机组人员和地面 11 人全部遇难。事故发生后，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 发布了紧急适航指令，禁止 MD-11 运行，直到完成所需的检查和纠正措施。美国国家运输安全委员会的调查记录了这起事故，并继续调查其情况。
UPS 随后决定退役其整个 MD-11 机队，而不是让飞机重新投入使用。然而，联邦快递在进行必要的检查后选择恢复运营，并将剩余的飞机再保留几年。两家公司现在面临同样的挑战，但他们的替代策略看起来却截然不同。
UPS 如何用波音 767 货机替换其 MD-11 机队
在 MD-11 退役之前，UPS 已经建立了大规模的波音 767 运营业务。根据 2025 年年度报告，该公司在其机队数据中列出了 26 架 MD-11 飞机，并确认其已在 2025 年第四季度永久停飞并退役整个型号飞机。据 AeroCorner 报道，截至年底，UPS 拥有 99 架波音 767-300 飞机，另有 18 架订单。
这使得 767 成为重建产能的自然选择。 UPS 不需要在运营中引入陌生的飞机，其现有机队为处理额外的货物提供了基础。据planespotters.net称，该公司还运营波音757、747和空客A300飞机，为其网络提供了其他配送货运的选择。
然而，退休也带来了经济成本。 UPS 在 2026 年 6 月的财务报告中报告称，该公司在 2026 年前六个月内已额外接收了 5 架波音 767-300 飞机。截至 2026 年 11 月，该航空公司已运营 110 架波音 767 飞机。公司将这些飞机作为融资租赁进行会计处理。该公司还承认，由于应对运力限制，MD-11机队的损失增加了第三方飞机租赁费用。
不过，有一个问题。就有效载荷或航程而言，波音 767-300F 并不是 MD-11 的直接替代品。 767 属于较小的宽体飞机类别，这意味着 UPS 不能简单地将每条以前的 MD-11 航线分配给单个 767 并期望获得相同的结果。一些货物可能需要通过额外的航班分配或转移到更大的飞机上。
UPS 可以在需要更大有效负载能力的较长航线上使用其波音 747 货机，而 767 则可处理较小的货物和较短的航段。这种方法使公司能够根据需求匹配飞机尺寸，但也需要仔细安排。与此同时，联邦快递选择在建立替换能力的同时继续保持 MD-11 的飞行。
为什么 FedEx 将剩余的 MD-11 保留到 2032 年
联邦快递正在采取缓慢得多的方式退役其 MD-11 机队。截至 2026 年 5 月 31 日，其 2026 年年度报告记录了 29 架 MD-11，以及 59 架波音 777F 和 152 架波音 767F。该公司计划在 2032 年底前退役剩余的三引擎飞机。
这一决定是在联邦快递早些时候改变其机队计划之后作出的。 2023 年，该公司计划在 2028 年底退役其 MD-11 机队。然而，它延长了 2025 年的最后期限，并解释说，修改后的时间表将更好地使飞机运力与预期发货量相匹配。换句话说，联邦快递认为，在需要更换产能之前，将飞机保留更长时间比将其撤回更有意义。
2025 年 11 月的停飞也扰乱了联邦快递的运营。该公司在年度报告中解释说，美国联邦航空局发布了一项紧急适航指令，禁止 MD-11 飞行，直到完成所需的检查和纠正措施。 2026 年 5 月，美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 批准波音公司制定的检查和恢复服务协议后，联邦快递 (FedEx) 开始将其飞机重新投入商业服务。预计整个机队将在 2026 年底恢复运营。

title_en: What Amenities Make An Airport Lounge Good? Here’s My Take…
title_zh: 机场休息室有哪些设施比较好？这是我的看法……
summary: What makes an airport lounge good depends on the lounge type. Here's what I expect from Priority Pass, business class, and first class lounges, and what sets the best apart.
summary_zh: 机场休息室的好坏取决于休息室的类型。以下是我对 Priority Pass、商务舱和头等舱休息室的期望，以及
body_en: I write a lot about airport lounges on the blog, ranging all the way from domestic lounges in the United States , to the best business class lounges , to the best first class lounges . When I rank the lounges that I like the most, some readers understandably have very different takes.
I thought it would be fun to start a discussion about basic expectations of airport lounges, and what makes them exceptional.
The basic value proposition of an airport lounge
Obviously lounge standards should differ depending on whether you’re using Priority Pass to access a lounge or are traveling in international first class, so we’ll get into more detail on that below.

Broadly speaking, what I’m looking for in a lounge is a (relatively) quiet place to sit, connect to Wi-Fi, recharge electronics, use a clean bathroom, and maybe have some water or coffee. Other things are good to have, but not something I necessarily expect.

There are also some deal killers for me when it comes to airport lounges. Personally, if a lounge is packed, I have no interest in being there , and that largely reflects that over the years, terminals have become much better places to spend time
Unlike a couple of decades ago, a vast majority of airports offer free Wi-Fi, so that’s not usually something that differentiates lounges anymore
Many gate seating areas have been improved with plenty of outlets; you can almost always find a completely deserted gate to sit at, with no one around

So unless you’re looking to chow down or drink up, you’re generally going to find more comfortable accommodations in the terminal. And before someone says “you’re so obsessed with privacy,” let me point out my biggest issue with crowding — it’s that there’s invariably going to be someone within earshot making a phone call or watching something without headphones .
I figured I’d share my expectations for lounges, and I’ll break it up into three tiers of lounges (admittedly some of the lines are blurred here)
The first tier of lounges are those belonging to Priority Pass, contract lounges, credit card lounges, and membership lounges
The second tier of lounges are those specifically for long haul international business class
The third tier of lounges are those specifically for long haul international first class
I think it’s also important to note that everyone is looking for different things in lounges
If you have a long connection, resting facilities can make or break a layover
If you’re traveling in long haul economy, chances are you’ll appreciate lounge food a lot more than someone traveling in business class, who hopefully has access to great food onboard
Some people are looking for a festive start to their trip, and just want to drink
I think the two below videos from Cathay Pacific from several years ago oh-so-beautifully sum up what makes lounges great. The commentary in the videos is almost poetic.
With that out of the way, let me share my basic expectations of various types of lounges, and admittedly these reflect my preferences and biases.

My expectations for Priority Pass lounges, airport contract lounges, airline membership lounges, and credit card lounges, are pretty simple. I’m happy if I can actually consistently get in and have a quiet place to sit. Sadly that’s not as straightforward as it may sound, with so many stories of lounges denying entry to club members, Priority Pass members, etc.
body_zh: 我在博客上写了很多关于机场休息室的内容，从美国国内休息室，到最好的商务舱休息室，再到最好的头等舱休息室。当我对我最喜欢的休息室进行排名时，一些读者的看法截然不同，这是可以理解的。
我认为开始讨论机场休息室的基本期望以及它们的独特之处会很有趣。
机场休息室的基本价值主张
显然，根据您是使用优先通行证进入休息室还是乘坐国际头等舱旅行，休息室标准应该有所不同，因此我们将在下面详细介绍。
一般来说，我在休息室里寻找的是一个（相对）安静的地方，可以坐下来，连接 Wi-Fi，给电子设备充电，使用干净的浴室，也许还可以喝点水或咖啡。其他东西是很好的，但不是我所期望的。
说到机场休息室，对我来说还有一些交易杀手。就我个人而言，如果休息室挤满了人，我就没有兴趣去那里，这在很大程度上反映了多年来，航站楼已经成为更好的消磨时间的地方
与几十年前不同的是，绝大多数机场都提供免费 Wi-Fi，因此这通常不再是休息室的区别所在
许多登机口座位区都得到了改善，并设有大量的出口；你几乎总能找到一个完全荒废的大门坐下来，周围没有人
因此，除非您想大吃大喝，否则您通常会在航站楼找到更舒适的住宿。在有人说“你太注重隐私了”之前，让我先指出我对拥挤的最大问题——那就是总是有人在听得见的范围内打电话或不戴耳机看东西。
我想我会分享我对休息室的期望，我会将其分为三层休息室（诚然，这里有些界限是模糊的）
第一级休息室是属于 Priority Pass、合同休息室、信用卡休息室和会员休息室的休息室
第二层休息室是专门为长途国际商务舱提供的休息室
第三层休息室为长途国际头等舱专用休息室
我认为还需要注意的是，每个人都在休息室寻找不同的东西
如果您的转机时间较长，休息设施可能会影响中途停留的成败
如果您乘坐长途经济舱旅行，您很可能会比乘坐商务舱旅行的人更喜欢休息室的食物，后者希望能够在机上享用美味的食物
有些人正在寻找一个节日的旅行开始，只是想喝酒
我认为下面两个来自国泰航空几年前的视频非常漂亮地总结了休息室的魅力。视频中的评论几乎充满诗意。
抛开这些，让我分享一下我对各种类型休息室的基本期望，不可否认，这些反映了我的偏好和偏见。
我对 Priority Pass 休息室、机场合同休息室、航空公司会员休息室和信用卡休息室的期望非常简单。如果我真的能一直进去并有一个安静的地方坐下来，我会很高兴。遗憾的是，这并不像听起来那么简单，有很多休息室拒绝俱乐部会员、优先通行证会员等进入的故事。

title_en: Which Hotel Credit Cards Offer Free Night Awards, And Are They Worth It?
title_zh: 哪些酒店信用卡提供免费住宿奖励，值得吗？
summary: Hilton, IHG, Marriott and World of Hyatt credit cards offer free night awards for an anniversary or spending. Here's how each works, and why I think they're worth it.
summary_zh: 希尔顿、洲际酒店集团、万豪和凯悦天地信用卡为周年纪念日或消费提供免费住宿奖励。以下是每种方法的工作原理，以及为什么我认为
body_en: Hotel credit cards are among the most underrated out there . Understandably a lot of people get cards like the Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card ( learn more ) and Chase Sapphire Reserve® Card ( learn more ) to maximize the rewards they’re earning for their spending , and that’s a great idea. These cards offer valuable bonus categories, no foreign transaction fees, great travel coverage, and more.

But I think supplementing one of those cards with hotel credit cards can make a lot of sense. That’s because hotel credit cards largely offer some incredible perks that more than justify the annual fee, including free hotel elite status , and even some free night certificates. So even if you’re not loyal to a hotel group, it’s easy to get outsized value.
In this post, I’d like to specifically look at which credit cards offer free nights as part of their rewards structure, how you can earn them, and if they’re worth it.
Hotel credit cards with free nights November 2026

There are hotel credit cards issued by Hilton Honors, IHG One Rewards, Marriott Bonvoy, and World of Hyatt, which offer the opportunity to earn free night awards. To be clear, I’m not talking about the ability to earn points, but instead, the ability to earn free night awards that can be redeemed at a set of properties.

These free nights come in different forms — some free night awards are offered for spending a certain amount on a card, and some free night awards are offered as an annual benefit just for having a card, with no spending required.

So let’s take a look at the details of how these free night awards work, and then we’ll talk about whether they’re worth it. Note that I’m focusing specifically on cards that offer free night awards on an ongoing basis (rather than as part of a welcome offer), and am also limiting this to cards that are open to new applicants.
Hilton Honors credit cards offering free night awards
Hilton Honors has two credit cards that give cardmembers the ability to earn free night awards

The Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card ( learn more ) has a $550 annual fee ( Rates & Fees ), and offers a free night award on the account anniversary every year (including the year in which the card is opened), a free night award if you spend $30,000 on the card in a calendar year, and another free night award if you spend a total of $60,000 on the card in a calendar year
The Hilton Honors American Express Surpass ® Card ( learn more ) has a $150 annual fee ( Rates & Fees ), and offers a free night award if you spend $15,000 on the card in a calendar year

Hilton Honors free night awards are my single favorite hotel free night awards out there, given that they have no category caps, and they’re valid for 12 months from when they’re issued. I value Hilton points at 0.5 cents each.

Hilton free night awards can be redeemed for standard rooms at properties costing up to 250,000 points per night, and there’s only a small list of excluded properties . They’re even valid at Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) properties that are part of the Hilton Honors partnership. It’s easy to redeem these at properties costing $1,000+ per night.
IHG One Rewards credit cards offering free night awards
IHG One Rewards has three credit cards that give cardmembers the ability to earn free night awards

The Brand New IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card ( learn more ) has a $350 annual fee, and offers a free night award on the account anniversary every year, valid at a property costing up to 60,000 points, plus another free night award if you spend $40,000 on the card in a calendar year
The New IHG One Rewards Business Credit Card ( learn more ) has a $200 annual fee, and offers a free night award on the account anniversary every year, valid at a property costing up to 50,000 points
The New IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card ( learn more ) has a $150 annual fee, and offers a free night award on the account anniversary every year, valid at a property costing up to 50,000 points
IHG One Rewards free night awards are also potentially quite valuable, and they expire 12 months from when they’re issued. I value IHG points at 0.5 cents each.

While IHG free night awards are capped at properties costing a certain number of points, what I really like is how you can top them off with an unlimited number of points. So if a hotel requires 100,000 points, you could use a 60,000 point free night certificate, and then top it off with 40,000 points.
body_zh: 酒店信用卡是最被低估的信用卡之一。可以理解的是，很多人都会购买 Chase Sapphire Preferred® 卡（了解更多）和 Chase Sapphire Reserve® 卡（了解更多）等卡，以最大限度地提高他们的消费回报，这是一个好主意。这些卡提供有价值的奖励类别、无国外交易费用、良好的旅行保障等等。
但我认为用酒店信用卡补充其中一张卡是很有意义的。这是因为酒店信用卡在很大程度上提供了一些令人难以置信的福利，这些福利不仅仅是年费的合理性，包括免费的酒店精英身份，甚至一些免费的住宿券。因此，即使您对酒店集团不忠诚，也很容易获得超额价值。
在这篇文章中，我想具体了解哪些信用卡提供免费住宿作为其奖励结构的一部分，如何赚取免费住宿，以及它们是否值得。
2026年11月可享免费住宿的酒店信用卡
希尔顿荣誉客会、洲际酒店集团 One Rewards、万豪旅享家和凯悦天地发行的酒店信用卡提供赚取免费住宿奖励的机会。需要明确的是，我不是在谈论赚取积分的能力，而是赚取可在一组酒店兑换的免费住宿奖励的能力。
这些免费住宿有不同的形式——一些免费住宿奖励是在卡上消费达到一定金额即可获得的，而一些免费住宿奖励则作为年度福利提供给持有卡的人，无需消费。
那么让我们来看看这些免费住宿奖励如何运作的细节，然后我们将讨论它们是否值得。请注意，我特别关注那些持续提供免费住宿奖励的卡（而不是作为欢迎优惠的一部分），并且还将其限制为向新申请人开放的卡。
提供免费住宿奖励的希尔顿荣誉客会信用卡
希尔顿荣誉客会拥有两张信用卡，持卡会员可以赚取免费住宿奖励
希尔顿荣誉客会美国运通 Aspire 卡（了解更多）年费为 550 美元（费率与费用），并在每年（包括开卡当年）账户周年日提供免费住宿奖励，日历年内持卡消费满 30,000 美元可获得免费住宿奖励，日历年内持卡总消费满 60,000 美元可获得额外免费住宿奖励
希尔顿荣誉客会美国运通 Surpass ® 卡（了解更多）年费为 150 美元（费率与费用），如果您在一个日历年内持卡消费满 15,000 美元，即可获得免费住宿奖励
希尔顿荣誉客会免费住宿奖励是我最喜欢的酒店免费住宿奖励，因为它们没有类别上限，并且自颁发之日起 12 个月内有效。我认为希尔顿积分每分 0.5 美分。
希尔顿免费住宿奖励可在每晚花费不超过 250,000 积分的酒店兑换标准客房，只有一小部分不包括在内的酒店。它们甚至适用于属于希尔顿荣誉客会合作伙伴的世界小型豪华酒店 (SLH)。在每晚价格超过 1,000 美元的酒店中可以轻松兑换这些优惠。
IHG One Rewards 信用卡提供免费住宿奖励
IHG One Rewards 拥有三张信用卡，持卡会员可以赚取免费住宿奖励
全新的 IHG One Rewards Premier Select 信用卡（了解更多）年费为 350 美元，并在每年的账户周年纪念日提供免费住宿奖励，适用于积分不超过 60,000 点的酒店，如果您在该卡上一年内消费满 40,000 美元，还可获得另一次免费住宿奖励
新的 IHG One Rewards 商务信用卡（了解更多）年费为 200 美元，每年在账户周年纪念日提供免费住宿奖励，在积分最高为 50,000 点的酒店有效
新的 IHG One Rewards Premier 信用卡（了解更多）年费为 150 美元，每年在账户周年纪念日提供免费住宿奖励，在积分最高为 50,000 点的酒店有效
IHG One Rewards 免费住宿奖励也可能非常有价值，并且在颁发后 12 个月后到期。我对 IHG 积分的评价是每个积分 0.5 美分。
虽然洲际酒店集团免费住宿奖励仅限于花费一定数量积分的酒店，但我真正喜欢的是如何用无限数量的积分来补充它们。因此，如果酒店需要 100,000 积分，您可以使用 60,000 积分的免费住宿礼券，然后再加上 40,000 积分。
